picks.title: Ema raises $77M as AI starts eating into enterprise software and services
picks.why_it_matters: With $140M raised and enterprise customers including Google and Microsoft, Ema validates the massive opportunity in AI agents replacing traditional enterprise software—a category early-stage founders should be building in.

picks.title: Claude discovers a novel enzyme system with CRISPR-like repeats
picks.why_it_matters: AI making genuine scientific discoveries signals a paradigm shift in biotech R&D, opening investment opportunities in startups building AI-native drug discovery and research platforms.

picks.title: Modal Motors is trying to cut China out of electric motors entirely
picks.why_it_matters: Rare-earth-free motors for drones and robots address a critical supply chain vulnerability, positioning this startup at the intersection of defense tech, robotics, and reshoring—all hot investment themes.
